senses.gloss: m. (עוּק h.) rundle of a ladder.—Pl. עֲוָקִים, עֲוָקִין, עֲוָו׳. Tanḥ. Vayetse 2; Pesik. Baḥod., p. 151ᵃ; Lev. R. s. 29, a. e., v. חַוָּוק. Y. B. Bath. III, end, 14ᵇ עד ג׳ ע׳ ככסא (not בכסא) a ladder of three or less rundles is considered a stool; Y. Sabb. III, end, 6ᶜ עד ג׳ ככסא (corr. acc.).
